024251:         state.updateMessages.set(
024252:           key,
024253:           {ok:false,kind:'update',text:t('updateFailed').replace('{error}',detail||'-')}
024254:         );
024255:       }else if(info.success===true){
024256:         // The orange PRÜFUNG… state already communicates successful install +
024257:         // pending verification. Keep the card quiet on success; only errors need
024258:         // an extra message below the card.
024259:         state.updateMessages.delete(key);
024260:       }
024261: 
024262:       state.actionProgress.delete(key);
024263:     }
024264:   });
